main_points: Proposed automation system for converting PDFs to PowerPoint presentations.
Supports large documents and ensures brand control over presentations.
User-friendly interface for uploading PDFs and customizing presentations.
important_facts: System extracts text from every page of the PDF.
Output remains editable in PowerPoint, avoiding Google Slides due to font issues.
Default target slide count is ten, adjustable based on content.
data_points: Uses Next.js for the user interface.
PDFs are saved to Google Drive and processed using n8n.
Template library JSON governs slide selection and content fitting.
potential_slide_messages: Automate your PDF to PPT conversion with ease.
Maintain brand integrity with controlled templates.
Efficiently summarize and outline your content.
risks_or_missing_context: Dependence on Google Drive for storage may pose accessibility issues.
Potential challenges in accurately summarizing complex PDFs.
Need for clear guidelines on template usage and image generation.
